reviewer: Codex /root/oer_compact_tests — bounded P reuse and changed-image/context inspection; exact runtime model identifier not exposed
method: All twenty existing bilingual P profiles and their forty concrete cases were read against current goal descriptions and direct prerequisite context. The twelve changed production PNGs were actually opened with view_image, followed by the twelve corresponding current PDF goal pages (pdftoppm, 1300px long edge; physical PDF page = goal page + 2). The eight unchanged rasters were not re-reviewed: their exact goal records, raster bytes and existing two-pass KEEP evidence are reused. The older source audit for the one-probability confidence diagram is reused only after checking unchanged source/mapping/composition files. This is not a D review, a human approval, learner-performance evidence or a strict-completion claim.

nativeDescriptionPreparation.descriptionReviewBoundary: Preparation and P context inspection only; independent D reviews and integration remain outside this artifact.

records.title: Argumentationsmuster von Hypothesentests erläutern
records.profileCheck: Retain both pre-specified decision examples: fair coin n=10, X>=9 with 11/1024; reliability p=0.9, X<=6 with 0.0127951984 and observed 7. Learners explain decisions and uncertainty, not construct a new test.
records.imageAndPageObservation: The observation arrow now points to the explicitly labelled category 5. The critical boundary lies between 4 and 5; the discrete category strip is explicitly schematic. Planning precedes observation, and non-rejection is not equated with proof of H0. Current goal page 1 binds this exact image to the test-reasoning goal and its binomial prerequisite.
resolvedHistoricalDissent: Current visualization remains unapproved for this candidate: Beobachtet wird laut Zähler X=5; der rote Beobachtungspfeil im Histogramm steht aber ungefähr in der Mitte der zwischen 0 und 20 bezeichneten Achse. Auf einer linearen Anzahlachse müsste 5 bei einem Viertel der Strecke liegen. Numerische Beobachtung und gezeichnete Position stimmen nicht überein.
records.resolutionEvidence: Actual current raster and corresponding PDF page inspected; concrete observation above.

records.title: Null- und Alternativhypothesen formulieren
records.profileCheck: Retain right/left/two-sided hypothesis formulation and the recoding q=1-p. Strict alternatives and complementary composite nulls stay explicit; no additional test calculation.
records.imageAndPageObservation: Unchanged valid two-pass KEEP reused; no new visual inspection claimed.

records.title: Testkennzahlen und Testvariablen bestimmen
records.profileCheck: Retain seed successes (n=40, p=0.75, observed 34, h=0.85) and complementary defect/sound coding (n=50, observed 3/47, p=0.04/0.96). Parameters, random variables and observations remain distinct.
records.imageAndPageObservation: The distribution B(20;0.10) is now explicitly restricted to the boundary p=0.10 of H0:p<=0.10. X counts defects, the observed value is 5, and its marker is at category 5. Current page 3 retains the separation from the following critical-region goal.
resolvedHistoricalDissent: Current visualization remains unapproved for this candidate: Auf H0:p≤0,10 folgt unqualifiziert 'Unter H0: X~B(20;0,10)'. Die zusammengesetzte Nullhypothese enthält auch p<0,10; B(20;0,10) ist nur die Randverteilung, nicht die Verteilung für jede wahre H0.
records.resolutionEvidence: Actual current raster and corresponding PDF page inspected; concrete observation above.

records.title: Entscheidungsregeln und Verwerfungsbereiche bestimmen
records.profileCheck: Retain exact right-tail threshold 15 for B(20;0.5), alpha<=0.05, and equal-tail two-sided B(12;0.5) region X<=2 or X>=10. Adjacent excluded thresholds demonstrate the discrete cutoff, not merely an asserted answer.
records.imageAndPageObservation: Unchanged valid two-pass KEEP reused; no new visual inspection claimed.

records.title: Fehlerwahrscheinlichkeiten berechnen
records.profileCheck: Retain independent n=10 right-tail and n=12 left-tail cases. Alpha/beta events and beta's alternative-parameter dependency are explicit; numeric values and complements are recalculated.
records.imageAndPageObservation: The old incorrectly shaped binomial bars are replaced by event-category strips. Under the explicitly fixed p=0.10, alpha is P(X>=5); under p=0.25, beta is P(X<5). The displayed beta is now correctly rounded to 0.415. Page 5 keeps rule construction as a prerequisite and error interpretation as the next goal.
resolvedHistoricalDissent: Current visualization remains unapproved for this candidate: Im oberen ausdrücklich als B(20;0,10) bezeichneten Histogramm ist der Balken bei 1 höher als bei 2. Tatsächlich ist P(X=2)>P(X=1), der Modus ist 2. Für das untere Beispiel ist P0,25(X<5)=0,4148415…, auf drei Nachkommastellen 0,415, nicht der angegebene Wert ≈0,414.
records.resolutionEvidence: Actual current raster and corresponding PDF page inspected; concrete observation above.

records.title: Fehler 1. und 2. Art deuten
records.profileCheck: Retain shipment-error interpretation and reversal of the protected null. Changing H0 changes the practical meaning of each risk without changing formal type-I/type-II definitions.
records.imageAndPageObservation: Unchanged valid two-pass KEEP reused; no new visual inspection claimed.

records.title: Testergebnisse im Kontext interpretieren
records.profileCheck: Retain observed 6/20 with given reject-at-5 rule and observed 7/50 with given reject-at-most-5 rule. Both supported and unsupported contextual conclusions are assessed without treating non-rejection as proof.
records.imageAndPageObservation: B(20;0.10) is qualified as the null boundary, the schematic bars peak at 2, and the observed 5 lies on the rejection side at its correct tick. Context wording says support, not proof. Page 7 is tied to interpretation after error types, not to a demand for a fresh test design.
resolvedHistoricalDissent: Current visualization remains unapproved for this candidate: Wie beim Testvariablenbild folgt aus H0:p≤0,10 unqualifiziert 'Unter H0 gilt: X~B(20;0,10)'. Diese Binomialverteilung gilt nur am Rand p=0,10 der zusammengesetzten Nullhypothese.
records.resolutionEvidence: Actual current raster and corresponding PDF page inspected; concrete observation above.

records.title: Gütefunktion und Teststärke untersuchen (LK)
records.profileCheck: Retain exact G(p)=4p^3-3p^4 and L=1-G; the second case compares explicit thresholds/sample sizes with recalculated alpha and power. No new values are inferred from the schematic image.
records.imageAndPageObservation: The schematic G and L curves now intersect at 0.5; their labelled complementary pairs are 0.3/0.7 and 0.7/0.3. L is non-rejection, G rejection, and beta/test strength are read at a fixed alternative. Page 8 and the canonical description use the same convention. Qualitative larger-n/alpha hints are not used as an exact pointwise monotonicity theorem for every discrete test design.
resolvedHistoricalDissent: Current visualization remains unapproved for this candidate: Die tatsächlichen blauen und orangefarbenen Kurven schneiden sich unterhalb der 0,5-Linie bei ungefähr 0,43. Für die ausdrücklich behauptete punktweise Beziehung G=1−L müssen beide Kurven sich bei Höhe 0,5 schneiden. In der Umgebung von p≈0,4 bis 0,5 summieren die gezeichneten Werte sich sichtbar nicht zu 1.
records.resolutionEvidence: Actual current raster and corresponding PDF page inspected; concrete observation above.

records.title: Tests vergleichen und bewerten (LK)
records.profileCheck: Retain two B(20;p) thresholds with explicit allowed-risk changes and the separate error-cost decision. The lower-alpha test is not universally better; the cases genuinely change the decision criterion.
records.imageAndPageObservation: For rejection at X>=k, alpha arrows now address the right H0 tail and beta arrows the left H1 portion. Both panels repeat the same decision rule; the larger threshold reduces rejection probability and power. Curves are explicitly schematic. Page 9 requires both contextual interpretation and power comparison.
resolvedHistoricalDissent: Current visualization remains unapproved for this candidate: Die mit α beschrifteten roten Fehlersymbole und Pfeile liegen links der kritischen Grenze unter H0; α gehört für Verwerfen bei X≥k zur rechten H0-Randfläche. Die mit β bezeichneten blauen Symbole/Pfeile liegen rechts von k unter H1; β gehört bei dieser Regel zur linken H1-Fläche X<k. Korrekte Begleittexte retten diese verkehrte räumliche Zuordnung nicht.
records.resolutionEvidence: Actual current raster and corresponding PDF page inspected; concrete observation above.

records.title: Prognoseintervalle für relative Häufigkeiten bestimmen
records.profileCheck: Retain known-p prediction interval at p=0.4,n=400, the fourfold-n width change, and rare-event normal-approximation failure at p=0.01,n=20. Unknown-p confidence is not substituted for prediction.
records.imageAndPageObservation: Unchanged valid two-pass KEEP reused; no new visual inspection claimed.

records.title: Konfidenzintervalle für Wahrscheinlichkeiten berechnen
records.profileCheck: Retain both score/inversion and symmetric Wald calculations for h=0.6 and h=0.1 at n=100,c=1.96. The asymmetric case prevents conflating the methods, and normal approximation is not sold as exact coverage.
records.imageAndPageObservation: The image now states the interval inequality and explicitly explains solving the boundary equation. The symmetric approximation is separately labelled, and 0.52 is centered between approximately 0.47 and 0.57. Fixed p versus repeated random intervals is retained. Page 11 binds these two methods to the same goal; literal LaTeX rendering is recorded separately, not silently cleared.
resolvedHistoricalDissent: Current visualization remains unapproved for this candidate: Im rechten Zahlenstrahl steht die Markierung 0,52 am linken Ende des als [0,47…0,57] beschrifteten Intervallbalkens. Sie muss dessen Mittelpunkt sein. Im 'genaueren Weg' wird ohne Kennzeichnung der Randgleichung durchgehend eine Gleichung statt der das ganze Intervall bestimmenden Ungleichung gezeigt. Das ist als Grenzberechnung möglich, verlangt aber die Klarstellung, dass die beiden Lösungen die Grenzen liefern.
records.resolutionEvidence: Actual current raster and corresponding PDF page inspected; concrete observation above.

records.title: Konfidenzniveau interpretieren
records.profileCheck: Retain hypothetical repeated-process expectation 190 out of 200 versus realized 187, and selection of one interval from twenty as a changed procedure. No actual learner experiment or guaranteed sample fraction is invented.
records.imageAndPageObservation: The explicit interval [0.50;0.54] does not contain the marked true p=0.57. In the repetition sketch the crossed red interval ends before the fixed-p line, unlike the green covering intervals. The text rejects the frequentist posterior misinterpretation. Page 12 correctly depends on interval construction.
resolvedHistoricalDissent: Current visualization remains unapproved for this candidate: Die mit roten Kreuzen als Nichtüberdeckung markierten Intervalle schneiden sichtbar dieselbe senkrechte p-Linie wie die mit Haken markierten. Auch das linke einzelne rote Intervall enthält den dargestellten p-Punkt, ist aber mit einem Kreuz versehen. Die Zeichen widersprechen der gezeichneten Mengenbeziehung.
records.resolutionEvidence: Actual current raster and corresponding PDF page inspected; concrete observation above.

records.title: Konfidenzdiagramme deuten (LK)
records.profileCheck: Retain the four recalculated scalar cuts: h=0.5 with n=100/400,c=1.96; h=0.5,n=100,c=2.58; h=0.6,n=100,c=1.96. The last interval excludes p=0.50. Earlier source ambiguity and old theta_1/theta_2 image objections are resolved by the existing source audit plus the actually inspected replacement.
records.imageAndPageObservation: The replacement explicitly has one unknown p horizontally and relative frequency h_n vertically. A vertical fixed-p cut is prediction; a horizontal observed-h_n cut yields the confidence interval for p. Both width comparisons and the inversion inequality are consistent. Page 13 and its direct interval prerequisite support this scalar interpretation. The unchanged source extraction, mapping and HE GK/LK views preserve the earlier source audit; no two-parameter inference or new source reading is claimed.
resolvedHistoricalDissent: Das aktuelle Raster verwendet eine zweidimensionale Parameterellipse (θ1,θ2), während die gebundenen Voraussetzungen einzelne Trefferwahrscheinlichkeiten und Intervallbreiten behandeln. Der Kandidat bleibt beim p-h-Konfidenzdiagramm; die beabsichtigte Ellipsenbedeutung sollte bei unabhängiger QS source-genau abgeglichen werden, ohne zusätzliche multivariate Inferenz zur Pflicht zu machen.

Current visualization remains unapproved for this candidate: Fachliche Scope-Frage: Das Raster führt zwei unbekannte Parameter und eine multivariate Konfidenzregion ein. Die aktuellen Voraussetzungen und benachbarten Intervallziele behandeln dagegen eine Trefferwahrscheinlichkeit p. Eine p-h-Konfidenzellipse dieses Schulkontexts ist nicht dieselbe Darstellung wie eine Region für (θ1,θ2). Der Wortlaut des Zieles allein entscheidet diese Kontextabweichung nicht sicher.
records.resolutionEvidence: Actual scalar p/h_n replacement inspection plus unchanged historical source-audit bindings.
